Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
Absolutely — I can help you get started.
If you're new to One Fast Cat, the main product to know is our Cat Exercise Wheel, which is designed to encourage an active lifestyle for cats.

A simple place to start




Learn what the wheel is
Our cat wheel is a large exercise wheel made for cats to run on safely.


Check whether it fits your space
One setup note: the wheel is about 50 inches tall on the base, so it helps to make sure you have enough room for it.


Plan for a short adjustment period
Some cats use it quickly, while others need time to get comfortable.




Beginner tip for introducing your cat

A helpful getting-started method is:
- Take the wheel off the base for the first few days and lay it on its side on the floor.
- Then gently encourage your cat to approach it with treats or toys.
This can help cats that feel intimidated by the full upright wheel at first.
